## Need

Describe the task someone needs to complete and what currently gets in the way.

## Proposed change

Explain the change, such as a new machine, recipe, or setting, and give a
concrete expected result.

## Alternatives and impact

Describe alternatives considered, affected machines, distros, or workflows, and
any compatibility or documentation changes. Link related work where relevant.
